Fortune Cookie Generator

Crack open a virtual fortune cookie — 40 original fortunes, each with six lucky numbers, ready to copy or share.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Crack a Cookie.
  2. Read your fortune and lucky numbers.
  3. Click to copy or crack another.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do I get per cookie?

40 original fortunes about luck, love, success, and adventure — plus six random lucky numbers each.

How are lucky numbers chosen?

Lucky numbers are random picks from 1–99, just like a real cookie slip.

How do I copy a fortune?

Click the fortune or its Copy button to copy the fortune and numbers together.
